reason: Distance-4 prefetch is a bounded change in the n=512 hot loops, though benefit is unverified and it may add issue pressure. The 64 KiB panel layout is more invasive; previous panel32 results were mixed and do not predict this layout. Joint end tests and indexed loads target the hot loops, but prior pointer-end results were mixed and indexed addressing may cost more. Transpose fusion and ZA remapping carry higher implementation and correctness risk. Tail alignment and a_transpose do not affect the n=512 path. The cache_blocking proposal describes a two-K body that conflicts with the supplied current one-K loop and overlaps a previously tested two-step unroll, so it should not be repeated as stated. No supplied result establishes a cache bottleneck or any proposal's gain.
